(Retrieved via WebFetch; condensed by fetch tool)

Format: indirect talks.
Negotiators & mediators:
- US: Special Envoy Steve Witkoff, Jared Kushner
- Iran: Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi (led technical team)
- Mediators: Qatar (Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani), Pakistan

Outcomes: Two meetings addressed (1) US violations of obligations, with agreement to "establish a communication channel to resolve disputes"; and (2) the $6 billion frozen Iranian funds, where sides agreed to purchase "required goods" based on Iran's needs.

Unresolved: no breakthrough toward lasting peace; nuclear programme access disputed (Iran bars IAEA inspectors from bombed sites: Fordow, Natanz, Isfahan); shipping route disputes continue.

Referenced as the "Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding". Next steps: negotiations to resume after funeral processions for former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.
